<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex026012026-11-0602-25-20" status="unreviewed">'di' mdo' dang sbyar na 'gog pa'i bar nas mi 'drar song zhes rigs so zhe na | 
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:86236">su ka ta shri</rs> <note type="editorial">=(ID:6616)?</note> na re mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i bar du bcug cing dang po nas 'gog pa'i bar du mar 'gro ba'i 'gres
				<lb edRef="inst:4652" n="183b8"/> yod pas na 'di nyid legs zer te mdo' na med do ||
				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> ni song pa ni yar song pa yin la | 'ongs pa ni mar 'ongs pa yin zhes 'gro ba ni 2 ka'i spyi sgra yin pas mi rigs pa med la | thod rgal la spyir 'gog pa'i bar du 'gro ba yang yod pa'i phyir ro zhes gsung ngo || </seg></TEI>
